channel.note: Widths and the fallback energy slope are explicit reduced-model assumptions, not surveyed channel dimensions. Manning n=0.04 is reported for the Lower Liffey in-bank domain in OPW Hydraulics Report section 4.7.3.7.

hydrograph.note: A normalised gamma-shaped design hydrograph represents the rising and receding limb; Qmed is used as the pre-event reference flow. It is not a reconstructed historical flood.

limitations: Educational design scenarios, not live forecasts or official flood maps.
Stage-driven equilibrium surfaces with connected flood spread; no momentum, velocity, or calibrated floodplain storage.
Reduced channel geometry and linear tidal attenuation are assumptions, not surveyed hydraulic structures.
No dynamic sewer, culvert blockage, groundwater, defence breach, reservoir-operation, wave, or storm-surge model.
The 2011 DTM and resampled outputs must not be used for individual property or road-safety decisions.
